newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums mostly unchanged in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums mostly unchanged in thin volume.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were unchanged to easier on Monday, traders said.
Outright prices fell in line with Dec IPE futures, which slipped $1.75 to 219.00 a tonne, but traders said business was quiet and demand scant.
Barge premiums were discussed around Dec IPE +$29, around unchanged from $28.50 done on Friday. Cargoes in northwest Europe were around Dec IPE +$30/31. No prompt requirements were seen.
In the Mediterranean premiums for Libyan material were around quotes cif high +$2.50/3.00, down around $1.
